title: Honey

source.name: Simple English Wikipedia — Honey
source.note: Chuyển thể sang mức A1 (câu ngắn, từ đơn giản); thông tin theo bài gốc.

paras: Honey is a sweet food. Bees make honey from nectar. Nectar comes from flowers. The bees keep the honey in a honeycomb. People can use honey instead of sugar.
Honey can taste different. It depends on the flowers that the bees use. Some honey is thick and some honey is light.
Honey does not go bad. Bacteria and other tiny living things cannot grow in it. Scientists found very old honey in ancient tombs in Egypt. It was still good to eat after thousands of years.
